description: Get term definitions from the "Terms and definitions" clause of the PDF specification (clause 3 of ISO 32000-2, clause 4 of ISO 32000-1 / pdf17). Returns structured definitions with term, definition text, notes, and sources.

spec.description: Spec ID (e.g. "iso32000-2", "pdf17"). Omit for the default spec.

term.description: Filter to definitions matching this term.

name: get_definitions
title: Get term definitions
